items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the internal valve fractured by frost. The gross estimate is €52 for one valve.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover the connection hose if it had to be renewed with the valve. The gross estimate is €27 for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary fitting-repair labour. Three hours at about €100 gross per hour give a line estimate of €299.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used on the repair, but §3.6(c) excludes the contractor’s own tools and small equipment. The generic entry does not establish what was used; €6 is a conditional allowance for minor documented consumables.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance for the covered repair. The closest same-wording cases support €41 gross for the visit.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to trace the escape. The €17.60 gross estimate is well below the €2,500 event cap for leak location.

items.description: Facade damage from the internal escape
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render damaged when escaped water froze within the wall, without the external-frost option. Because the line names damage rather than a specific task, €160 is conditional on it pricing distinct repair work not repeated elsewhere, as required by §§7.1.12–7.1.13.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of failed render from the damaged patch. The gross estimate is €150 for one removal unit, provided it is not already priced in line 7.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the affected patch. The reference-based gross estimate is €38.
Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require the work to be identified and allocated to the covered repair; this entry does neither. The €45 gross estimate is conditional on proof of a distinct minor repair task.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers re-forming the substrate in the damaged area. The reference-based gross estimate is €31.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(d) cover the affected area only, with as many coats as the like-for-like finish system requires. The gross estimate is €59 if all four coats are required.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary drying before reinstatement of the wall saturated by the internal escape. The reference-based gross estimate is €254.
Section 7.1.7(c)–(d) covers priming needed to restore the finish on the damaged patch. The reference-based gross estimate is €117.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers labour on the affected patch. Five hours at about €55 gross per hour give a reference-based line estimate of €277.

Sections 3.6(b), 7.1.12 and 9.6 exclude administrative fees and require a lump sum to identify covered work. The entry identifies none; €35 gross is conditional on proof that it prices a separate covered task.
